points.point: Old July invoice still showing after card update
Dashboard won't open after the card update (still failing after a fix they tried)

verdict.reason: The customer is following up on a billing issue after already updating their card, and the dashboard still fails after that attempt, so this is a still-failing case and a question about their own account's invoice that no entry's sentences answer; the closest entry (subscription-setup-incomplete) covers a stuck payment and tells them not to retry, which does not match this message, so it should go to a person.
